in_sanskrit.name: महेश्वर

in_marathi.name: Maheswar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maheswar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahesh (Mahésh) refers to Lord Shiva in Hindu mythology, the god of destruction and regeneration. Maheswar is a compound of Maha (great) and Ishwara (Lord), meaning 'Lord of the Gods'.

in_bengali.name: Maheswar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Gods
in_bengali.long_meaning: Maheswar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mahesh (Mahésh) refers to Lord Shiva in Hindu mythology, the god of destruction and regeneration. Maheswar is a compound of Maha (great) and Ishwara (Lord), meaning 'Lord of the Gods'.
